final_lessons: Starting baseline: moderate-depth wide MLPs with layer-norm tend to be reliable for multivariate regression.
Higher-capacity wide MLPs without layer-norm outperform narrow or heavily-normalized ones on this dataset.
The width-256 unnormalized MLP consistently gives the lowest test MSE on this dataset.
Width-256 unnormalized shallow MLPs remain the top performers on this dataset.
Width-256 unnormalized MLPs continue to dominate over narrow/normalized alternatives.
Width-256 unnormalized MLPs remain the strongest choice on this dataset.
The shallow width-256 fully-unnormalized MLP is the consistent top performer.
Absent width-256, favor the shallowest widest MLP with least layer-norm.
The width-256 unnormalized MLP remains the top pick whenever present.
Among width-256 options, fully unnormalized ones beat those with any layer-norm.
